info.name: EquipHub
info.description:
Campus equipment lending, tested through the API gateway.

Before running:
1. Pick the "EquipHub - local" or "EquipHub - EC2" environment.
2. In the environment, set adminPassword (Current value) to ADMIN_PASSWORD from registration-service/.env.
3. Run "node scripts/make-expired-token.js" from the repo root and paste the output into expiredToken (Current value).

Then run the folders in order (Collection Runner, or one request at a time). Login and create requests save tokens and ids into the environment for the requests after them.
Each run adds a short tag (runTag) to emails and item names, so the collection can run again against the same database.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Log in as the first admin (created from registration-service/.env), register and log in two students, and let the admin create a second admin. The login requests save the tokens into the environment.

exec: // A short tag for this run. It goes into emails and item names, so the collection
// can run again against the same database without "already exists" errors.

request.description: The first admin is created by registration-service on startup from ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD. Put that password into the environment variable adminPassword (Current value).
A second student, used later to show that one student cannot cancel another student's loan.
Only an admin token gets through the gateway on this route.

item.name: 2. Equipment CRUD
item.description: An admin adds five items, then lists, filters, reads and updates them. Every response includes "instance" (equipment-1 or equipment-2), the replica that answered.

exec: pm.test("availableQty is 3, the client's 99 is ignored", () => pm.expect(data.equipment.availableQty).to.eql(3));

request.description: availableQty is sent as 99 on purpose: the service ignores it and starts at totalQty.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Canon EOS M50 #{{runTag}}",
  "category": "camera",
  "description": "Mirrorless camera with 15-45mm kit lens",
  "totalQty": 3,
  "availableQty": 99
}

exec: pm.test("At least the 5 new items", () => pm.expect(data.count).to.be.at.least(5));
pm.test("Every item is a camera", () => data.equipment.forEach((item) => pm.expect(item.category).to.eql("camera")));
pm.test("Every item has a unit available", () => data.equipment.forEach((item) => pm.expect(item.availableQty).to.be.above(0)));

item.name: 3. Loan flows
item.description: Three loan lifecycles: borrow -> approve -> return, borrow -> cancel, and borrow -> reject. Borrowing reserves a unit in the equipment service; ending a loan gives it back.

exec: pm.test("equipmentName copied from the equipment service", () => pm.expect(data.loan.equipmentName).to.include("Canon EOS M50"));
pm.test("The new loan is listed", () => pm.expect(data.loans.map((l) => l._id)).to.include(pm.environment.get("loanId")));
pm.test("The new loan is there", () => pm.expect(data.loans.map((l) => l._id)).to.include(pm.environment.get("loanId")));
pm.test("dueDate is about 3 days from now", () => { const days = (new Date(data.loan.dueDate) - Date.now()) / 86400000; pm.expect(days).to.be.within(2.5, 3.5); });
pm.test("At least the 3 loans from this folder", () => pm.expect(data.count).to.be.at.least(3));
pm.test("Only approved loans past their dueDate", () => data.loans.forEach((l) => { pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("approved"); pm.expect(new Date(l.dueDate)).to.be.below(new Date()); }));

request.description: Approved loans past their dueDate. Usually empty; to see one, change an approved loan's dueDate to yesterday in Atlas.

item.name: 3.12 Stock is back after the loans ended
4. Load balancer
item.description: Send these two requests one right after the other. nginx alternates between the two equipment replicas, so "instance" changes.

exec: console.log("Answered by", data.instance, "- previous was", pm.environment.get("lastInstance"));

item.name: 5. Negative tests
item.description: Every rule that should say no. The "Setup" requests create the loans the next tests need, and the "Cleanup" requests end them, so no stock stays reserved.
